name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Worth watching, though 2029 specs can still evolve as you note. The nearer test for Broadcom's custom silicon story is Dec 9 earnings, with Q4 consensus around $3.83 EPS on ~$34.9B revenue.
財報前 IV Rank 94、IVP 99.2%，波動率確實到了罕見的高位。關鍵不在高本身，而是 12/9 財報後 IV crush 之後能不能守住相對高的基準，這才是判斷多空的關鍵。$AVGO
11月5日 AVGO 跌超10%、逼近52周低点那天，木头姐的 ARKK 反手清了约99%的持仓，约1.04亿美元。Barchart 说这笔卖出可能在12月9日财报前付出代价。 $AVGO

The capex number is the part that matters for AVGO: $1.07T toward semis and servers, plus $158.5B for network gear. But the market is only pricing 2% EPS growth, so the gap between spending plans and delivered earnings is the risk. Dec 9 will be a useful check.

BNEF's numbers are striking: data-center power demand quadruples to 2,354 TWh by 2035, about 7% of global electricity. Power is becoming as much of a bottleneck as chips, and Broadcom's custom silicon and networking sit right in the middle of that buildout. $AVGO
This is the AVGO angle that matters here. If most of Anthropic's token generation runs on Google-Broadcom TPUs, the Dec 9 earnings call should say a lot about whether the order-cut talk has any legs.
今天感恩节休市，补个基本面：Zacks 昨天盘了下博通的资产负债表，债务从 67.1B 降到 61.1B，现金升到 24B，Q3 自由现金流 137 亿、占收入 46%，2027 财年没有到期本金。表外约 29B 的 AI 租赁担保还在，空方不会放过这点。 $AVGO

The financing angle is the one to watch here. Broadcom’s guarantee is contingent: it only bites if Anthropic defaults and rack value falls short. A junk rating would still tighten funding behind that $900B compute plan. Dec 9 will tell us if the ~$115B FY27 guide holds.

Nomura's note is a useful reality check on CPO. If adoption keeps slipping, that leg of the optical story moves further out and NPO does the near-term work. For AVGO it doesn't change the near-term question: Dec 9, and whether the ~$115B FY27 AI guide holds.
博通软件这边也有消息：VMware 安全通告 VMSA-2026-0011，一次修了 23 个漏洞，其中 vCenter 有个 9.8 分的身份验证绕过 CVE-2026-123903。新漏洞目前没有在野利用的报告，不过上周那个 CVE-2026-123890 已经被确认利用、进了 CISA 目录。 $AVGO

Custom AI demand is the right lens here, but the numbers still need to prove out. AVGO closed at $301.08, still below its 20- and 50-day averages, so I'll wait for Dec 9 to see if management reaffirms the ~$115B FY27 AI guide.
